site.name: digital garden
site.author: grace
site.welcome: explore what I'm thinking and learning about in this little corner of the internet.
site.about:
A digital garden is a personal website for collecting ideas and letting them grow. It's closer to a notebook than a blog: nothing here is finished, and most of it is still changing.

Instead of a feed, the garden is organized by connection. Every thought is filed next to the ones it's related to, and the topics grow out of the thoughts rather than the other way around. You're meant to wander: follow a nearby thought, follow another, end up somewhere you didn't mean to go.

It's also a way of thinking in public without performing! With the increasing pressures of social media, I've come to realize that having a space to myself is cathartic, in a way.
